svg.title: PicForLater flat icon
svg.desc: A minimal flat picture outline with a filled bookmark modifier.
svg.metadata: PicForLater composition based on the visual grammar of Microsoft Fluent UI System Icons: Image (regular) with a Bookmark (filled) modifier.
